title: Independent DXF reader diversity and LibreDWG loss boundaries
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and plan update
scope: Screen additional open-source DXF readers for independent route value
Separate uncad's LibreDWG-backed DWG path from its undxf DXF path
Bound Binary-DXF subset tooling and modeler coverage
Refresh official LibreDWG class and conversion loss caveats
Refine the existing implementation-ready peer and local validation gates

sources.observation: The project is read-only. Its DWG path uses vendored/patched LibreDWG through FFI, while ASCII/Binary DXF uses the separate undxf crate. Its caveats describe legacy SAT groups and modern ACDSDATA/SAB DXF paths, bounded ACIS wireframe projection, and explicit unsupported/unknown dispositions. Its reported corpus counts and capabilities are self-reported and were not reproduced here.

The published manifest identifies an MIT, safe-Rust DXF reader for the uncad-model schema. The uncad project describes this as its independent ASCII/Binary DXF route, distinct from LibreDWG. Normalized model equality alone may conceal raw-record or omitted-field differences.

The ISC-licensed repository documents one-pass R13+ Binary-DXF scanning, a bounded common-entity list, borrowed strings, and Unknown preservation for unrecognized types. The repository shows one commit and no release; it does not document modeler/ACDSDATA semantics, writing, whole-document validation, or external acceptance.

sources.project: SeaCad / Sea-DXF-Core license and design statement
sources.observation: The project states that its source is proprietary and that source visibility does not grant permission to use or redistribute it. It was excluded from implementation/code comparison; no code or corpus was accessed or reused.

LibreDWG documents version- and class-specific read/write caveats, including ignored/unhandled or proxy/placeholder classes and conversion coverage that is not a lossless parity claim. These statements are peer self-documentation and were not reproduced against a pinned executable/input.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-06/PAR-07/S2: distinguish parser lineage, class dispatch, conversion, writer, and consumer loss stages
PAR-07/S7: admit undxf only as an optional pinned DXF parser differential; compare raw groups and normalized typed values separately
PAR-07/S8: preserve per-source entity, handle, block occurrence, carrier, and unsupported/loss disposition
PAR-07/S8: keep wireframe projection distinct from B-rep, analytic geometry, independent-kernel, and native-consumer evidence
assessment.planImpact: Add no peer dependency. Treat undxf as an optional independent DXF syntax/carrier candidate only; uncad's DWG path shares LibreDWG and its ACIS output is wireframe evidence. Treat dxfscan as a narrow Binary-DXF subset candidate. Preserve LibreDWG class/converter degradation as stage-local, per-object disposition requirements. Keep local generated fast tests first and external semantic/native gates composed.

method.limitations: Project README/caveat statements and published crate metadata were reviewed but not independently reproduced. uncad's corpus statistics and ACIS behavior remain peer claims; its DWG reader shares LibreDWG. dxfscan has a limited documented entity set and an immature repository state. No new geometry truth, native application outcome, or local parser defect was obtained.
